grain: one row per publication, joinable to dataset.parquet and embeddings.parquet on UT

derived_from.status: assumed, not recorded by the producer; consistent with a consistency check (see embedding_consistency_check)

provenance: Copied unchanged from archive/biodiversity-literature-app/data/umap_coordinates.parquet (the web app's layout). The UMAP library version, hyperparameters, random seed and the script that produced it were NOT recorded; the layout cannot be regenerated from this repo.

embedding_consistency_check.method: 20,000 random articles; share of each article's 10 nearest neighbours in the 768-d embedding space (cosine) that are also among its 10 nearest in the 2-d UMAP space
embedding_consistency_check.reading: about 270x above chance, so the layout is clearly built from embeddings like these. It cannot distinguish these exact vectors from another embedding model run on the same title+abstract text.
